about: Smart Lab assistant evaluation (2026-10-26). Uses the frozen system prompt + snapshot exported from the isolated copy database (ctx.json). kind: snapshot = answerable from the snapshot, must contain every 'all' item and one of each 'any' group; tools = the snapshot does not hold it: the model must answer NEED_TOOLS (pass 1) and then call the expected tool (pass 2); unknown = nothing in the data: the model must say so and must not invent a number. instant = answered from the database before any model (agent.quick_answer); scored end to end only (e2e_ask.py).
